# Pokémon Showdown provenance

PLC's generated move-semantics artifact was built from the move definitions in `pokemon-showdown@0.11.11`, applying the historical generation layers used by the VW2R adapter. Pokémon Showdown is a build-time semantic reference; it is not a runtime dependency and is not the damage-formula engine.

Upstream source: <https://github.com/smogon/pokemon-showdown>

Pinned package: `pokemon-showdown@0.11.11`

The complete upstream MIT license is included beside this file.
